name: definition-history-table-subdivision-quarters-sum-mismatch
description: Invalid definition (fiscalclock 0.3.0), rejected by the cross-block checks, which run only when the definition has no block-level error. An entry's table subdivision is checked against the entry's own year block, at the prefixed path: with 2024-02-26 removed, 2024 holds 12 listed periods, but quarters sum to 13. The dates are illustrative. The complete error list is asserted (code and path of each error, sorted by path, then code).

source.citation: spec/definition-v1.md, year and subdivision type table and Cross-block checks (fiscalclock 0.3.0, ADR-0022), and spec/api-v1.md error catalogue
